name: Fan
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on August 1st, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 33 of the August 2020 Challenge A as well as July II challenge (2021).
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
Two windmills are going on a date. One asks the other "So, what kind of music do you like?" The other windmill responds "I'm a big metal fan."

Garage description
